name: Melee Wand-Wielder
body:
You have integrated magic wands into your combat style.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (dagger), caster level 3rd

Benefit(s): You may wield a wand in melee as though it were a dagger, and using dagger traits and statistics, and leverage additional benefits from the magic within. You may spend a swift action to expend charges from the wand to grant yourself a bonus to attack and damage rolls with it. For every 2 charges you expend the wand gains a +1 enhancement bonus to a maximum of 1/2 the level of the spell it contains, rounded down. This bonus lasts for a number of rounds equal to the level of the spell in the wand. In addition, you may make an attack with the wand as a standard action, if successful you may expend 2 charges from the wand to activate it as a free action, instead of its normal casting time. If the spell has an area of effect you choose if the point of origin is your square or the square containing the target of your attack.
